heading.zh-Hant: 出身、求學與報人流亡時期
heading.en: Birth, studies and years as editor and exile

body.zh-Hant: 康斯坦丁·帕茨1874年2月23日生於佩爾瑙縣塔胡蘭納教區的塔胡村。他1894至1898年就讀塔爾圖大學法學院並以優等成績畢業，取得法學候補士（cand. jur.）學位。1901至1905年他在塔林創辦報紙《Teataja》；1905至1906年因政治因素流亡瑞士伯恩附近，1906至1909年流亡芬蘭；1910至1911年被單獨囚禁於聖彼得堡的十字架監獄，1911至1916年出任《塔林報》（Tallinna Teataja）總編輯。
body.en: Konstantin Päts was born on 23 February 1874 in Tahku village, Tahkuranna parish, Pärnu county. From 1894 to 1898 he studied law at the University of Tartu, graduating cum laude as cand. jur. In 1901–1905 he founded the newspaper Teataja in Tallinn; he lived as a political exile near Bern in Switzerland in 1905–1906 and in Finland in 1906–1909, was held in solitary confinement in St Petersburg's Kresty prison in 1910–1911, and was editor-in-chief of Tallinna Teataja in 1911–1916.

heading.zh-Hant: 獨立建國與制憲會議時期

body.zh-Hant: 1917年帕茨在耶爾瓦縣設立選舉團並當選議員，進入地方議會（Maanõukogu）；1917至1918年任臨時省政府（Maavalitsus）主席，1918年為拯救委員會成員，其後被捕，送進德國的拘留營五個月。1918至1919年他任臨時政府的總理兼戰爭部長（pea- ja sõjaminister），短時間也兼內政部長。制憲會議（Asutav Kogu）自1919年4月23日運作至1920年12月20日，帕茨名列議員；官方介紹並稱1919年選舉的四個主要名單之一是「帕茨領導的 Maaliit」。
body.en: In 1917 Päts set up an electoral college in Järva county and was elected a deputy to the provincial assembly (Maanõukogu); in 1917–1918 he chaired the provisional provincial government (Maavalitsus), in 1918 he was a member of the Salvation Committee, and was then imprisoned and sent to a German prison camp for five months. In 1918–1919 he was prime minister and war minister of the Provisional Government (pea- ja sõjaminister) and briefly also interior minister. The Constituent Assembly (Asutav Kogu) sat from 23 April 1919 to 20 December 1920 and Päts is listed among its members; the official account also names the 'Maaliit led by Konstantin Päts' among the four main lists of the 1919 election.

heading.zh-Hant: 國會議員、議長與歷任國務長老
heading.en: Riigikogu member, Speaker and State Elder

body.zh-Hant: 1920年帕茨以農民聯盟（Põllumeeste Kogud）名單當選第一屆國會（Riigikogu）議員，該屆國會自1920年12月20日運作；1922年11月20日至1923年6月7日他任國會議長。他先後擔任國務長老（Riigivanem）：1921至1922年、1923至1924年、1931至1932年，以及1932至1933年的跨黨派信任政府。此外，1919至1933年他也是保險股份公司「愛沙尼亞勞合」（Eesti Lloyd）的董事長。
body.en: In 1920 Päts was elected to the first Riigikogu on the Farmers' Assemblies (Põllumeeste Kogud) list; that parliament sat from 20 December 1920, and from 20 November 1922 to 7 June 1923 he was its Speaker. He served as State Elder (Riigivanem) in 1921–1922, 1923–1924 and 1931–1932, and in 1932–1933 in a non-partisan confidence government. In 1919–1933 he also chaired the insurance company Eesti Lloyd.

body.zh-Hant: 國務長老帕茨組織了1934年3月12日的政變；3月15日他與萊多納（Laidoner）宣布全國戒嚴，並以命令延後國會與國務長老的選舉。1934至1937年他以「代行國務長老職務的總理」身分治國。1937年8月17日他宣布新憲法，且未交付公民投票；同年9月3日他開始履行「Riigihoidja」職務，這個職位在新國會就位前合併了國務長老與總理的權力。
body.en: State Elder Päts organised the coup of 12 March 1934; on 15 March he and Laidoner proclaimed a nationwide state of emergency, and by decree he postponed the elections of the Riigikogu and of the State Elder. In 1934–1937 he governed as 'prime minister in the duties of the State Elder'. On 17 August 1937 he proclaimed the new constitution without submitting it to a referendum, and on 3 September 1937 he took up the post of Riigihoidja, which until the new parliament began work combined the powers of State Elder and prime minister.

heading.zh-Hant: 總統任期、1940年下台與晚年
heading.en: Presidency, the 1940 downfall and last years

body.zh-Hant: 1938年1月28日他以命令設立愛沙尼亞科學院；1938至1940年任愛沙尼亞共和國總統，並是1938年當選的首任總統。1939年他宣布愛沙尼亞中立，並同意基地協定。1940年6月21日政變後，他在蘇聯最後通牒政府的要求下簽署大量文件，7月21日辭去總統職務，7月30日與家人被送往俄羅斯烏法。他1956年1月18日死於加里寧州的布拉舍沃（Buraševo）。
body.en: On 28 January 1938 he founded the Estonian Academy of Sciences by decree; in 1938–1940 he was President of the Republic of Estonia, the first president, elected in 1938. In 1939 he declared Estonia neutral and accepted the bases agreement. After the coup of 21 June 1940 he signed a large number of documents at the demand of the ultimatum government, resigned the presidency on 21 July 1940, and on 30 July was deported with his family to Ufa in Russia. He died on 18 January 1956 at Buraševo in Kalinin oblast.

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館的人名權威檔記載，尼泊爾國王特里布萬（Tribhuvan）生於1906年、卒於1955年。美國國會圖書館的國別簡介說明，拉納家族的首相建立了統治至1951年的王朝，法理上的君主地位被降為儀式性，君主或被流放、或被軟禁；該簡介並把特里布萬的在位期標為1911至1955年。
body.en: The German National Library's authority file records Tribhuvan, King of Nepal, as born in 1906 and dead in 1955. A Library of Congress country profile explains that the Rana dynasty of prime ministers ruled until 1951 and reduced the de jure monarchy to a ceremonial position, with monarchs either exiled or kept under house arrest, and dates Tribhuvan's reign 1911–55.

body.zh-Hant: 英國圖書館瀕危檔案計畫的館藏目錄說明記載，特里布萬生於加德滿都，自1911年12月11日起為尼泊爾國王，直到逝世為止（1950至51年的一段期間除外）。他在父親普利特維・比爾・比克拉姆・沙阿去世後，五歲即登上王位，並於1913年2月20日在加德滿都哈努曼多卡王宮的納薩爾喬克加冕，由母親攝政。同一說明指出，首相昌德拉・舒姆舍爾（Chandra Shumsher）在加冕當時掌握全權。
body.en: A British Library catalogue description records that Tribhuvan was born in Kathmandu and was King of Nepal from 11 December 1911 until his death, apart from a period in 1950–51. He ascended the throne at the age of five on the death of his father, Prithvi Bir Bikram Shah, and was crowned on 20 February 1913 at the Nasal Chowk, Hanuman Dhoka Palace in Kathmandu, with his mother acting as regent. The same description states that Maharaja Chandra Shumsher was exercising full power at the time of the crowning.

body.zh-Hant: 馬拉戈蒂（Mara Malagodi）2023年的論文記載，1950年11月6日，特里布萬國王攜全家（4歲的孫子賈南德拉除外）出宮，闖入加德滿都的印度大使館尋求庇護；四天後，印度空軍飛機把王室送往新德里。拉納政府勸返國王未成，讓王子賈南德拉登基，但印度與英國都不承認新君。德里同時進行談判，達成妥協後，國王於1951年2月15日返回加德滿都，復位標誌拉納政權正式結束；2月18日他頒布王室宣言，成立由拉納與尼泊爾大會黨代表組成的臨時政府。
body.en: Mara Malagodi's 2023 article records that on 6 November 1950 King Tribhuvan and his whole family, except his four-year-old grandson Gyanendra, left the palace and entered the Indian Embassy in Kathmandu to seek sanctuary; four days later an Indian Air Force plane flew the royal family to New Delhi. After a failed attempt to persuade him to return, the Rana government crowned Prince Gyanendra, but India and the United Kingdom refused to recognise the new monarch. Negotiations took place in Delhi; after a compromise the king returned to Kathmandu on 15 February 1951, and his restoration marked the formal end of the Rana regime. On 18 February he issued a Royal Proclamation forming an interim government with Rana and Nepali Congress representatives.

heading.zh-Hant: 復位後的直接統治與王室宣言

body.zh-Hant: 馬拉戈蒂指出，尼泊爾大會黨的柯伊拉臘（M.P. Koirala）首屆政府任期為1951年11月16日至1952年8月14日；其後特里布萬國王於1952年8月14日至1953年6月15日直接統治。1954年1月10日，他頒布王室宣言，把王權確立為國家一切權力的來源。德國國家圖書館權威檔另載，他的出生地為加德滿都，逝世地為蘇黎世。
body.en: Malagodi notes that the first Nepali Congress government under M.P. Koirala lasted from 16 November 1951 to 14 August 1952, followed by a period of direct rule by King Tribhuvan from 14 August 1952 to 15 June 1953. On 10 January 1954 he issued a Royal Proclamation establishing the crown as the source of all state authority. The German National Library authority file also records Kathmandu as his place of birth and Zürich as his place of death.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、求學與地方行政歷練

body.zh-Hant: 海因里希·薩姆1877年9月12日生於安克拉姆。他1896年中學畢業後，在慕尼黑、柏林與格賴夫斯瓦爾德研讀法學與國家學；1900年通過司法見習考試，1904年通過候補文官考試。他1906年被選為馬格德堡專職市參事，1912年被選為波鴻（第二）市長；第一次世界大戰期間，1915至1918年任德國駐華沙民政當局的市政事務官。1919年2月他被選為但澤上級市長（Oberbürgermeister）。
body.en: Heinrich Sahm was born in Anklam on 12 September 1877. After his Abitur in 1896 he studied law and political science in Munich, Berlin and Greifswald, passed the Referendar examination in 1900 and the Assessor examination in 1904. He was elected a salaried city councillor in Magdeburg in 1906 and (second) mayor of Bochum in 1912; during the First World War he served in 1915–18 as municipal affairs officer in the German civil administration of Warsaw. In February 1919 he was elected Oberbürgermeister of Danzig.

heading.zh-Hant: 但澤自由市：參議院議長
heading.en: The Free City of Danzig: President of the Senate

body.zh-Hant: 但澤脫離德國後仍留在受國際聯盟監督的但澤自由市，薩姆以無黨派的資產階級人士身分，在1920至1930年擔任三屆跨黨派參議院的議長。他赴國聯、與波蘭談判，並曾對蘇聯進行國事訪問，因此成為外交舞台上的行動者。1929年他禁止「鋼盔團」在但澤舉行活動；第三屆參議院於1930年被德意志民族主義者與納粹黨推翻。
body.en: After Danzig was separated from the Reich, Sahm stayed in the Free City under the League of Nations and, as a non-party bourgeois politician, presided over three non-partisan Senates in 1920–30. Travel to the League of Nations, negotiations with Poland and a state visit to the Soviet Union made him an actor on the diplomatic stage. In 1929 he banned a Stahlhelm event in Danzig, and his third Senate was overthrown in 1930 by German Nationalists and National Socialists.

body.zh-Hant: 薩姆1931年4月14日被選為柏林上級市長；他是納粹獨裁前最後一位柏林市長。1932年他為興登堡的第二次總統競選籌劃選戰；1933年4月加入納粹黨，納粹並派尤利烏斯·利珀特（Julius Lippert）任國家專員在他身邊，逼他辭職。1935年12月9日他辭去市長職務。
body.en: On 14 April 1931 Sahm was elected Oberbürgermeister of Berlin, the last Berlin city head before the Nazi dictatorship. In 1932 he organised Hindenburg's second presidential campaign; in April 1933 he joined the NSDAP, and the Nazis put Julius Lippert at his side as state commissioner, pushing him toward resignation. He resigned on 9 December 1935.

body.en: Sahm was appointed German envoy to Norway: the Neue Deutsche Biographie gives 1937, while the German National Library's authority file gives 'Botschafter in Norwegen 1936-1939', so the sources differ on the year. In Oslo he disregarded instructions about monitoring political emigrants, among them Willy Brandt. He died in Oslo on 3 October 1939; the 2001 reasoning of the Berlin Senate describes him as envoy of the Nazi regime in Norway until his death.
